files.availability.sql:
SELECT service,
       COUNT(*) AS total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN status >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors,
       ROUND(
         1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
         3
       ) AS availability
FROM requests
GROUP BY service
ORDER BY service;
